name: Toki
tagline: Set your timers and alarms by typing durations or times in the menu bar.
description:
Toki is a keyboard-first timer, alarm, and stopwatch for Mac. It lives in the menu bar and accepts short natural-language time expressions, giving people who prefer launchers and shortcuts a faster alternative to adjusting clock controls with the pointer.

Type `25` to start a 25-minute timer, `30s` for 30 seconds, or a clock time such as `3pm` to count down to an alarm. Stopwatch mode counts upward, while an optional message records what the interval is for.

## Features

- Start countdowns by entering minutes, seconds, combined durations, or a target clock time.
- Run a stopwatch from the same compact keyboard-driven interface.
- Label a timer with a message so its purpose is visible when it finishes.
- Add an interval tick sound when audible pacing is useful.
- Keep time visible from the menu bar without opening a larger productivity workspace.
- With Toki Pro, place the timer in the MacBook notch, along a screen edge, or in a movable floating display, and cycle through additional faces.

## Where it fits

Toki suits people who want to set an ordinary timer as quickly as they would run a command in Raycast. It works for cooking, meetings, presentations, short breaks, and informal focus sessions without requiring projects, statistics, or a Pomodoro routine.

It is deliberately narrower than a focus tracker. Choose Balance or Session when interval planning and a record of completed work matter more than rapid timer entry. Toki is also still in early access, so its interface, feature boundaries, or pricing may change before the developer considers it stable.

## Privacy and requirements

Toki requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later and is distributed as a disk image from the developer's website. Its privacy policy states that the app does not collect or store personal information. License activation necessarily uses the purchased key, and the current license can be active on up to two devices.

## Pricing

Toki can be downloaded and used for free. Toki Pro is a $13.99 one-time purchase with future updates included; an early-access discount may be available from the developer.
